help.intro: A discount only applies once every piece below is set up correctly - use this as a checklist before you publish one.
help.step_1_body: Give it a label, pick a reason, and set the type (percent or fixed amount) and value.
help.step_2_body: Scope decides what the discount can apply to: the whole order, or a specific set of products, categories or brands.
help.step_3_body: Every scope except "order" needs at least one target - use the target picker to link the products, categories or brands it should apply to. Without one, the discount is saved but matches nothing.
help.step_4_body: Add a minimum order value, restrict it to certain countries, or limit it to an hour and day range. Leave a condition empty to skip it.
help.step_5_body: Start and end dates control when the discount is live. Leave both empty for a discount that is active as soon as it is created.
help.note: Changing a discount's scope replaces its targets for the new scope - the previous scope's targets are cleared, not kept in reserve.
